control_title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
requirement_in_plain_words: Know what assets exist, where they live and who owns them.
aws_implementation: AWS Config recording enabled in all regions; mandatory Owner and DataClass tags enforced by an AWS Organizations tag policy.
github_implementation: Repository inventory pulled from the org API; CODEOWNERS file in every repo.
evidence_artifact: AWS Config resource inventory export; tag-compliance report.
test_procedure: Inspection: compare the Config inventory with the asset register. Sample 10 resources and confirm each has a valid Owner tag.

requirement_in_plain_words: Access rules are defined from business and security requirements and enforced.
aws_implementation: IAM Identity Center permission sets per job role; Service Control Policies deny actions outside the access control policy.
github_implementation: Org base permission set to None; access granted through teams only.
evidence_artifact: Permission set definitions (Terraform); SCP JSON documents.
test_procedure: Inspection: trace 3 roles from the access control policy to their permission sets and confirm least privilege.

requirement_in_plain_words: Passwords, keys and secrets are created, distributed, rotated and protected under defined rules.
aws_implementation: IAM password policy meets baseline (14+ chars, complexity, reuse prevention 24); IAM access keys rotated every 90 days or less; app secrets in Secrets Manager with rotation.
github_implementation: Secret scanning with push protection; fine-grained tokens with expiry of 90 days or less.
evidence_artifact: IAM password policy JSON; IAM credential report.
test_procedure: Re-performance: run the collector and inspect the credential report for active keys older than 90 days.

requirement_in_plain_words: Access is granted, reviewed regularly and removed promptly when no longer needed.
aws_implementation: Quarterly review of Identity Center assignments; joiner-mover-leaver automation driven by the HR system.
github_implementation: Quarterly review of org members and outside collaborators.
evidence_artifact: Signed access review records; leaver tickets matched to deprovisioning timestamps.
test_procedure: Inspection: sample 5 leavers from the period and confirm access was removed within 24 hours.

requirement_in_plain_words: Security risks from suppliers are identified and managed before and during the relationship.
aws_implementation: Third-party risk questionnaire (CAIQ) for AWS Marketplace and SaaS vendors handling customer data.
github_implementation: Review of third-party GitHub Apps and Actions before approval; allow-list of Actions.
evidence_artifact: Supplier register with risk tier; completed questionnaires.
test_procedure: Inspection: sample 3 critical suppliers and confirm a current assessment exists.

control_title: Information security for use of cloud services
requirement_in_plain_words: Security for acquiring, using and exiting cloud services is defined and managed.
aws_implementation: AWS Organizations guardrails; Security Hub foundational standards enabled; shared-responsibility matrix documented.
evidence_artifact: Cloud security standard; Security Hub compliance score.
test_procedure: Inspection: confirm guardrails are deployed to every account in scope.

control_title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
requirement_in_plain_words: The organization plans and prepares for handling security incidents.
aws_implementation: IR runbooks; GuardDuty findings routed via EventBridge to on-call paging.
github_implementation: Security incident issue template; private vulnerability reporting enabled.
evidence_artifact: Incident response plan; tabletop exercise report.
test_procedure: Inspection: confirm the plan is approved and a tabletop exercise was held in the last 12 months.

requirement_in_plain_words: Privileged access is restricted, controlled and monitored.
aws_implementation: Root user protected with hardware MFA and no access keys; break-glass role with alerting on use.
github_implementation: No more than 3 org owners; admin actions require 2FA.
evidence_artifact: IAM account summary; CloudTrail query for root sign-ins.
test_procedure: Re-performance: run the collector; query CloudTrail for root activity during the audit period.

requirement_in_plain_words: Access to information is restricted in line with the access control policy.
aws_implementation: S3 Block Public Access enabled at account level; bucket policies deny non-TLS access.
github_implementation: Repositories private by default; members cannot change repository visibility.
evidence_artifact: S3 Control public access block configuration.
test_procedure: Re-performance: run the collector. Observation: attempt a public ACL in a sandbox account and confirm it is denied.

requirement_in_plain_words: Authentication is implemented securely, including MFA where risk requires it.
aws_implementation: MFA required for every IAM user with console access; workforce sign-in through IdP SSO.
test_procedure: Re-performance: 100% population test of console users using the collector.

requirement_in_plain_words: Vulnerabilities are identified, evaluated and fixed in a timely way.
aws_implementation: Amazon Inspector scanning EC2, ECR and Lambda; remediation SLA by severity (critical 7 days).
github_implementation: Dependabot alerts and security updates enabled on all repos.
evidence_artifact: Inspector findings ageing report; Dependabot alert history.
test_procedure: Inspection: sample 10 critical findings and confirm each was fixed within SLA.

requirement_in_plain_words: Secure configurations are defined, applied, monitored and reviewed.
aws_implementation: Terraform is the source of truth; AWS Config conformance pack detects drift.
github_implementation: Infrastructure code reviewed through pull requests.
evidence_artifact: Conformance pack results; terraform plan output from CI.
test_procedure: Inspection: review the drift report and trace 5 configuration changes to approved pull requests.

requirement_in_plain_words: Backups are taken and regularly tested according to policy.
aws_implementation: AWS Backup plans with Vault Lock; quarterly restore test.
evidence_artifact: Backup job reports; restore test record.
test_procedure: Re-performance: restore one sampled resource and confirm data integrity.

requirement_in_plain_words: Logs of activities and events are produced, protected, stored and analysed.
aws_implementation: Multi-region organization CloudTrail with log file validation; log bucket with S3 Object Lock and KMS encryption.
github_implementation: Audit log streaming to the central log bucket.
test_procedure: Re-performance: run the collector; run digest validation on a sampled day of logs. See 04-control-narrative.

requirement_in_plain_words: Networks, systems and applications are monitored for anomalous behaviour and acted on.
aws_implementation: GuardDuty enabled in every region; findings routed to Security Hub and on-call.
github_implementation: Secret scanning alerts routed to the security channel.
test_procedure: Re-performance: run the collector; generate a sample finding and trace it to a ticket.

requirement_in_plain_words: Networks and network devices are secured and managed.
aws_implementation: No security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 to SSH or RDP; admin access through SSM Session Manager.
test_procedure: Re-performance: run the collector in every region in scope.

requirement_in_plain_words: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including key management, are defined and applied.
aws_implementation: EBS encryption by default; customer-managed KMS keys with automatic rotation; TLS 1.2 or higher.
evidence_artifact: EBS default encryption setting; KMS key rotation status.
test_procedure: Re-performance: run the collector; inspect KMS key policies for least privilege.

requirement_in_plain_words: Changes to systems are subject to change management procedures.
aws_implementation: Production deploys only through the pipeline role; SCP blocks console changes in production.
github_implementation: Branch protection: required review, required status checks, no force push.
evidence_artifact: Branch protection settings; sample of merged pull requests.
test_procedure: Inspection: sample 25 production deployments and confirm each maps to an approved pull request.
